Our highly skilled, fully certified technicians will return your car to pristine condition or produce virtually any paint customization vision imaginable. Amazing job!! Thank you. - Alex C. | If you want efficiency and great body work this is your place. The workers are very friendly and are dedicated to their work. Thanks! - Michael J. | Doral Collision does beautiful work. I wrecked the whole front of my Porsche and they restored it back like new. My insurance company recommended them and I'm happy they did.
